propositions: Mapped project keys that are decommissioned or permission-denied pass syntactic validation but fail at fan-out as ACLI errors, leaving live Jira unguarded against deep mutation failures
legacy_default is returned verbatim from resolve_project without validation, causing unbound/legacy tickets to write to wrong or nonexistent projects without cross-project guard constraints

A reconcile-pass preflight must enumerate all required project keys (mapped projects + legacy_default + fallback query_project) via Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search and validate visibility before any outbound mutation occurs

Preflight validation must fail closed on transport/auth errors (TransportUnavailableError) and distinguish ProjectVisibilityError for missing keys, blocking reconcile_once until all required projects are confirmed visible
Preflight enforcement must be gated to Cloud backend only, mutating passes only, and produce an actionable PassResult with OPERATIONAL_FAILURE disposition when projects are missing or unreachable
